name: Chevron
author: E. T. Carter
description: Beveled chevron ribbons scrolling upward — bold zigzag bands with lit crests and shadowed edges so they read as folded 3D ribbon, colour stepping band to band. Confident, rhythmic, architectural.

params.label: Band count
params.effect: How many chevron bands stack up the frame; low is bold, high a fine weave.

params.label: Zigzag
params.effect: How many V-peaks run across the frame; low is wide chevrons, high tight zigzags.

params.label: Point depth
params.effect: How sharply the V's point; 0 flattens to straight bands, high makes steep arrows.

params.label: Scroll
params.effect: How fast the chevrons scroll; 0 holds them still.

params.label: Mouse influence
params.effect: How strongly the pointer scrolls the bands; 0 ignores the mouse.
